an5.12:1.5: imesaṃ kho bhikkhave pañcannaṃ sekhabalānaṃ etaṃ aggaṃ, etaṃ saṅgāhikaṃ, etaṃ saṅghātaniyaṃ yadidaṃ paññābalaṃ.
an5.12:2.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave kūṭāgārassa etaṃ aggaṃ, etaṃ saṅgāhikaṃ, etaṃ saṅghātaniyaṃ yadidaṃ kūṭaṃ,
an5.12:2.2: evameva kho bhikkhave imesaṃ pañcannaṃ sekhabalānaṃ etaṃ aggaṃ, etaṃ saṅgāhikaṃ, etaṃ saṅghātaniyaṃ yadidaṃ paññābalaṃ.
an5.12:3.2: saddhābalena samannāgatā bhavissāma sekhabalena, hiribalena …pe… ottappabalena …pe… viriyabalena …pe… paññābalena samannāgatā bhavissāma sekhabalenāti.
